adept_core.table.blade.desc: Speed and combos. A field blade with focus sockets.
adept_core.table.hammer.desc: Power and crowd control. Charged piston strike.
adept_core.table.hammer.later: The hammer prototype comes in a later version.
adept_core.table.choose.hint: Choose your melee weapon. The other option stays locked for the whole playthrough.
adept_core.table.result.not_chosen: Choose the pair and build the prototype first
adept_core.resonator.none: The resonator is silent: no nodes in range
adept_core.camp.wrong_world: The camp can only be deployed in the overworld
adept_core.camp.already: A camp is already deployed — fold it first (sneak + use the rig)
adept_core.camp.no_node: No dormant node nearby (must be within %s blocks of the crystal)
adept_core.camp.no_space: Not enough room for the rig and the gateway
adept_core.camp.deployed: Camp deployed. Level %s node, waves: %s. Stay close or extraction pauses.
adept_core.camp.folded_early: Camp folded before cleansing: extraction progress lost
adept_core.camp.broken: The extraction rig is broken! Repair it (use an iron ingot on it)
adept_core.wave.final: Final wave %s of %s — the node guardian is coming
adept_core.trader.not_cleansed: The trader can only be called from a cleansed node
adept_core.trader.already: The trader was already called from this node
adept_core.step.blade.emitter.edge.1.des: The blade field gets denser. Every direct hit with the blade in your main hand deals %s more damage, %s per hit in total.
adept_core.blade.stats: %s damage per hit, %s hits per second.
adept_core.blade.steps: Upgrades are shown on the artifact table.
adept_core.seed.desc: The artifact table is built from the seed: put it in the center of a crafting grid with 4 gold ingots, 2 copper blocks and 2 glass around it. On its own it does nothing.
adept_core.seed.safe: Does not burn, does not vanish on the ground and stays with you after death. A lost seed is returned by /adept seed.
adept_core.table.heavy.desc: Plates soak most damage, servos run on electricity. Built for long fights.
adept_core.table.light.desc: The chestplate holds a mana shield that takes damage before your health. Mana comes from the accumulator. Without mana there is no shield, only armor 6. The chestplate focus answers hits on the shield.
adept_core.table.gauss.desc: A stream of needles from a magazine; the barrel heats up.
adept_core.table.choose.hint.0: Choose a melee weapon. The other option stays locked for the whole playthrough.
adept_core.table.choose.hint.1: Choose your armor. The other option stays locked for the whole playthrough.
adept_core.table.choose.hint.2: Choose a ranged weapon. The other option stays locked for the whole playthrough.
adept_core.table.light.later: The light exosuit prototype comes in a later version.
adept_core.table.rail.later: The railgun prototype comes in a later version.
adept_core.step.heavy.chest.bastion.1.de: An intact plate absorbs %1$s%% of its share of damage (%2$s%% without this step). The rest reaches your health; a broken plate lets its whole share through.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.tempo.1.des: The gun fires faster: up to %1$s shots per second instead of %2$s.
adept_core.heavy.part.head: Head
adept_core.heavy.install: To fit a plate: armor in main hand, plate in off hand, right-click.
adept_core.gauss.hint: Right-click to fire. Shift + right-click to switch template and reload. Charges at the base.
adept_core.gauss_table.name: Gauss Gun
adept_core.gauss_table.subtitle: Artifact · upgrades %s of %s
adept_core.gauss_table.lore.barrel: The barrel accelerates the needle. It sets damage and fire rate.
adept_core.gauss_table.lore.coils: Coils keep the needle on axis and spend charge on every shot.
adept_core.gauss_table.lore.cooler: The cooler takes heat off the barrel and prevents overheating.
adept_core.gauss_table.lore.battery: The battery stores charge for shots.
adept_core.gauss_table.lore.magazine: The magazine holds needles and sets their feed order.
adept_core.gauss_table.lore.scope: The scope zooms in on the target and highlights it.
adept_core.gauss_table.title: Gauss gun: segment upgrades
adept_core.gauss_table.open.desc: Six segments. Each has two paths of three steps and an apex.
adept_core.gauss_table.hint: Drag to rotate. Scroll to zoom.
adept_core.gauss_table.choose: Pick a segment under the model. Its two paths and apex will show here.
adept_core.gauss_table.details.segment: Pick a segment, then a step.
adept_core.gauss_table.details.node: Pick a step or the apex to see its description and cost.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.boost.1.des: Needles fly 30%% faster and farther: 62 blocks instead of 48.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.boost.2.des: Needles ignore 30%% of the target's armor.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.boost.3.des: A needle pierces the first target and keeps flying. The second target takes 70%% damage.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.tempo.2.des: Autofire: while the button is held the gun fires on its own, 5 shots per second.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.tempo.3.des: Spin-up: over 2 seconds of continuous fire the rate grows by 50%%.
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.apex.1.name: Apex: Arc Discharge
adept_core.step.gauss.barrel.apex.1.desc: A hit has a 25%% chance to strike the nearest enemy within 6 blocks with lightning: 50%% damage and the rune effect. Fire rate and range +15%%.
A shot kicks the aim up half as much.
Spread does not grow while running.
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.economy.1.de: A shot uses 15%% less electricity: 3.4 instead of 4.
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.economy.2.de: Another 15%% less: a shot costs 2.8 electricity.
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.economy.3.de: Every fifth shot uses no electricity.
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.apex.1.name: Apex: Impulse
adept_core.step.gauss.coils.apex.1.desc: During continuous fire every tenth needle is empowered: double damage, pierces 2 targets. Accuracy and economy +15%%.
The barrel heats 20%% slower: 4%% per shot instead of 5%%.
Bursts of up to 5 shots do not heat the barrel.
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.purge.1.des: Emergency heat purge: heat drops to zero at once. Cooldown 20 seconds.
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.purge.2.des: The purge scalds enemies within 3 blocks with steam: 4 damage.
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.purge.3.des: Purge cooldown is 12 seconds instead of 20.
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.apex.1.name: Apex: Mana Circuit
adept_core.step.gauss.cooler.apex.1.desc: When overheated the gun keeps firing on mana: 6 mana per shot. Heatsink +15%%.
adept_core.step.gauss.battery.capacity.1: 600 electricity instead of 400. Enough for 150 shots.
adept_core.step.gauss.battery.recuperati: Killing an elite enemy returns 60 electricity.
The mana converter loses 25%% instead of 50%%.
adept_core.step.gauss.battery.apex.1.des: At 90%% charge or more you can release 300 electricity as a 5-block ring: 8 damage, enemies are pushed away and stunned for 2 seconds. Capacity and recovery +15%%.
The magazine holds 45 needles instead of 30.
adept_core.step.gauss.magazine.pattern.1: A second magazine template. Switched with a key, applies on the next reload.
adept_core.step.gauss.magazine.pattern.2: Each template gets its own rule for missing needles: skip the slot, take any needle, or stop loading.
adept_core.step.gauss.magazine.pattern.3: A shot has a 20%% chance not to use up a needle.
adept_core.step.gauss.magazine.apex.1.de: Switching the template reloads the magazine at once; needles of the old order return to the inventory. Cooldown 10 seconds. Volume +15%%, reload 1.7 seconds instead of 2.
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.lens.1.name: Lens I
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.lens.2.name: Lens II
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.lens.2.desc: A weak-point hit deals another +30%% damage.
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.lens.3.name: Lens III
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.scanner.2.de: Targets within 12 blocks are visible through walls.
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.scanner.3.de: Targets show weak points. Hitting one deals +25%% damage.
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.apex.1.name: Apex: Mark
adept_core.step.gauss.scope.apex.1.desc: Needles that miss are pulled to the marked target if they pass within 2 blocks of it. Highlight range and weak-point bonus +15%%.
adept_core.component.variant.magic: Held together by runes and crystals, charged with mana
adept_core.component.variant.tech: Plain alloy, no runes, charged with electricity
adept_core.component.no_recipe: No recipe yet. Get it with /adept component
adept_core.accumulator.hint: Keep it in your inventory: artifacts draw charge from it on their own.
adept_core.cauldron.hint: Right-click: souls from the vessel into the furnace. Shift + right-click: swap the vessel with the one in your off hand.
adept_core.vessel.hint: To put it into the soul cauldron, hold the vessel in your off hand and shift + right-click with the cauldron.
adept_core.table.singles.hint: Single artifacts have no pair. Build them at any time, and again if one is lost.
adept_core.table.accumulator.desc: Carried in the inventory. Mana and electricity sit in two separate stores and flow into artifacts without loss. At the base it charges from the base stores.
adept_core.table.soul_cauldron.desc: Carried in the inventory. Mobs you kill leave souls. The cauldron collects them when you are close, burns them into mana and passes it to the accumulator. Now and then the furnace yields a soul core, the Alliance currency.
adept_core.step.accumulator.core.capacit: Each accumulator store (mana and electricity) holds %1$s instead of %2$s.
adept_core.step.cauldron.furnace.yield.1: The furnace draws %1$s%% more mana from a soul: a normal one gives %2$s, a strong one %3$s, a guardian soul %4$s.
adept_core.focus.name: Focus: %s
adept_core.focus.blank: Focuses are cut on the cutting machine.
adept_core.focus.effect.knockback: Enemies within %1$s blocks are thrown back, push strength %2$s.
adept_core.focus.effect.flash: Enemies within %1$s blocks are blinded for %2$s s.
adept_core.focus.effect.slow: Enemies within %1$s blocks are slowed for %2$s s, slowness level %3$s.
adept_core.focus.trigger: Triggers when the shield takes a hit, at most once every %1$s s. Costs %2$s suit mana.
adept_core.focus.modifier.lapis: Economy: a trigger costs %3$s%% of the usual mana.
adept_core.focus.modifier.amethyst: Growth: durability restores itself, 1 unit every %1$s s.
adept_core.focus.modifier.emerald: Luck: %2$s%% of triggers cause no wear.
adept_core.focus.modifier.diamond: No special property, but very durable.
adept_core.focus.cracked: Cracked and inactive. Repair it on the cutting machine.
adept_core.light.install: Hold the focus in your off hand and the suit in your main hand, then right-click. Shift+right-click with an empty off hand removes the focus.
adept_core.step.light.chest.capacity.1.d: The shield holds %1$s units instead of %2$s. Each unit stops 1 damage before it reaches your health and recharges for %3$s suit mana.
adept_core.rune.base.current: A discharge jumps to the two nearest enemies within %9$s blocks and deals %1$s to each.
adept_core.rune.base.flame: The target burns for %2$s s. If it dies while burning, the fire spreads to its neighbours.
adept_core.rune.base.bond: The target is bound to the nearest enemy for %3$s s: %4$s%% of the damage to one is dealt to the other.
adept_core.rune.base.echo: After %5$s s the hit repeats on the target at %6$s%% strength.
adept_core.rune.base.rift: A rift of radius %8$s opens at the impact point for %7$s s: enemies in it are slowed and take damage.
adept_core.rune.base.pull: The impact point pulls in nearby enemies.
adept_core.rune.base.frost: The target freezes for %10$s s. If it dies frozen, the shards deal %11$s to its neighbours.
adept_core.rune.base.void: The target loses %13$s%% of its armor for %12$s s.
adept_core.rune.facet.current: the effect jumps to a neighbouring target at %17$s%% strength.
adept_core.rune.facet.flame: a burning zone stays at the impact point for %7$s s.
adept_core.rune.facet.bond: the effect is shared with the nearest enemy, who gets %17$s%%.
adept_core.rune.facet.echo: after %5$s s the effect triggers again at %17$s%% strength.
adept_core.rune.facet.rift: the effect anchors at the point and hits enemies within %8$s once a second for %7$s s.
adept_core.rune.facet.pull: enemies are pulled to the impact point before the effect.
adept_core.rune.facet.frost: the effect also freezes the target.
adept_core.rune.word.storm.desc: A cloud rises over the impact point and strikes enemies within %16$s with lightning for %15$s s, %14$s damage each.
adept_core.rune.word.eruption.desc: A vent opens at the impact point: for %15$s s it burns and hurts enemies within %16$s.
adept_core.rune.word.arcane.desc: The target and the two nearest enemies are pulled together and stunned by the collision.
adept_core.rune.word.double.desc: A copy of the shot flies on and hits every enemy on the line at half strength.
adept_core.rune.word.glacier.desc: An ice field of radius %16$s covers the impact point for %15$s s: enemies on it are frozen in place.
adept_core.rune.word.black_hole.desc: The impact point pulls in enemies and their projectiles for %15$s s.
adept_core.rune.word.superconductor.desc: An undamped discharge hits every enemy within twice the word radius and briefly freezes each one.
adept_core.rune.word.ash.desc: The target burns for 5 s and hits weaker the whole time.
adept_core.rune.word.pit.desc: Enemies within %16$s of the impact point are thrown up and take fall damage.
adept_core.rune.word.shards.desc: The target is covered in ice and a second later bursts into shrapnel: %14$s damage to everyone within %16$s.
adept_core.rune.ward.current: Ward: the attacker is stunned for %18$s s.
adept_core.rune.ward.flame: Ward: the plate puts out fire on you.
adept_core.rune.ward.bond: Ward: %19$s%% of the damage to the plate moves to a neighbouring intact plate.
adept_core.rune.ward.echo: Ward: a broken plate restores itself to %20$s%% once.
adept_core.rune.ward.rift: Ward: when the plate breaks, nearby enemies are slowed for %22$s s.
adept_core.rune.ward.pull: Ward: projectile damage to the plate is %21$s%% lower.
adept_core.rune.ward.frost: Ward: an enemy hitting you up close is slowed for %22$s s.
adept_core.rune.ward.void: Ward: magic damage to the plate is %21$s%% lower.
adept_core.rune.word.lightning_rod.desc: The attacker and enemies within 3 blocks are stunned twice: at once and a second later.
adept_core.rune.word.fire_ring.desc: When health drops below half, enemies within 3 blocks catch fire and are thrown back. At most once every %23$s s.
adept_core.rune.word.reflection.desc: Once every %23$s s a hit goes entirely into a plate, your health is untouched.
adept_core.rune.word.ice_wall.desc: After a hit of %25$s damage or more, enemies in front are thrown back and slowed. At most once every %23$s s.
adept_core.rune.word.distortion.desc: An enemy projectile misses you with a %27$s%% chance.
adept_core.rune.word.static_shell.desc: Enemies within 3 blocks of you are slowed.
adept_core.rune.word.tempering.desc: Fire and lava do not hurt you.
adept_core.rune.word.rooting.desc: After standing still for 2 s, damage is %26$s%% lower.
adept_core.rune.word.ice_cocoon.desc: A lethal hit leaves you at 1 health and freezes you in a cocoon: 3 s of near invulnerability. At most once every %24$s s.
adept_core.rune.material_line: Multiplier ×%s, the engraving survives pickup with a %s%% chance. %s
adept_core.rune.modifier.copper: Chain: the effect may jump to the nearest target.
adept_core.rune.modifier.gold: Response: every trigger returns a little mana to the accumulator.
adept_core.rune.modifier.red_gold: Harmony: two identical runes strengthen each other.
adept_core.rune.modifier.diamond: Clarity: rifts, clouds and fields are larger and last longer.
adept_core.rune.modifier.emerald: Luck: a special word may trigger twice.
adept_core.rune.modifier.lapis: Economy: the engraving uses half the material.
adept_core.carver.second_locked.hint: A second rune on cast items is unlocked by the carver step Precision I: artifact table, singles tab.
adept_core.carver.status.empty: Insert needles, bolts or a plate
adept_core.rail.hint: Hold right-click for %s s while the capacitor charges, then release. Shift+right-click picks the bolts.
adept_core.bolt.hint: Rail gun bolt. A bolt that survives the shot lies where it hit.
adept_core.table.rune_carver.desc: Built on a crafting table. Its steps are unlocked here and apply to the whole base.
adept_core.step.rail.barrel.pierce.1.des: Bolt damage is %1$s%% higher. A bolt pierces %3$s targets instead of %2$s, and %4$s%% of the damage ignores armor.
adept_core.step.carver.precision.1.name: Precision I
adept_core.step.carver.precision.1.desc: The carver puts %1$s runes on a cast item. An exact pair of runes forms a special word.
death.attack.adept_core.rail_pierce: %1$s was pierced by a rail gun bolt
death.attack.adept_core.rail_pierce.play: %1$s was pierced by %2$s's rail gun bolt
